text: n + 1 into n; prefix remainders.

The pigeonhole principle (鸽巢原理): putting n + 1 objects into n boxes forces some box to hold two. Stronger form: kn + 1 objects force some box to hold k + 1. It proves that something must exist, and the proof usually tells you where to look.

Classic use: among any n integers there is a non-empty block al + … + ar divisible by n. The n + 1 prefix sums S0 … Sn have only n possible remainders mod n, so two are equal; their difference is the block. The proof is the O(n) algorithm.
Prints l and r such that al + … + ar is divisible by n; the first repeated remainder is reported. Checked against the same rule in Python.

Other pigeonhole facts: among n + 1 numbers from 1 … 2n two are consecutive; any sequence of mn + 1 distinct numbers has an increasing run of length m + 1 or a decreasing one of length n + 1 (Erdős– Szekeres).
OGF for combinations, EGF for arrangements.

A generating function (母函数) packs a sequence into a power series. Ordinary (普通型 , OGF): A(x) = Σ anxn; multiplying OGFs counts combinations: picking 0 … ci items of type i is (1 + x + … + xci), and the product's xn coefficient counts the ways to pick n items in total.

Exponential (指数型 , EGF): A(x) = Σ anxn/n!; multiplying EGFs counts arrangements (labelled objects, strings): a letter used k times contributes xk/k!, and n! times the xn coefficient counts strings of length n.
Taylor series give closed forms: Σ xk = 1/(1 − x), Σ xk/k! = eˣ, even k: (eˣ + e⁻ˣ)/2.

OGF: ways to pick 6 items when the four types allow at most 2, 3, 1, 4 copies; EGF: strings of length 6 over {a, b, c} with an even number of a's and at least one b. Both are checked by brute force in Python. Products of large series use FFT / NTT (第8章).

title: P/N 状态、巴什游戏与置换群

text: Backward tables; Bash game; cycles.
P-positions and N-positions: a position is P (the Previous player, who just moved, wins) when every move leads to an N-position; it is N (the Next player wins) when some move leads to a P-position.
Terminal positions are P. Filling this table backwards is the basic method for any small game (and SG = 0 ⇔ P, 第10章).

Bash game (巴什游戏): one pile of n stones, take 1 … m per move, taking the last stone wins. P-positions are exactly the multiples of m + 1: from a multiple, every move leaves a non-multiple; from a non- multiple, taking n mod (m + 1) leaves a multiple. So the first player wins iff n mod (m + 1) ≠ 0.

The table for moves {1, 3, 4} shows P-positions at 0, 2, 7, 9, 14, 16, …: period 7. Tabulating, then spotting the period, is how most "formula" games are discovered.

A permutation group (置换群) is a set of permutations closed under composition, containing the identity and inverses (rotations of a necklace, rotations and reflections of a square). Every permutation splits into disjoint cycles; a colouring is fixed by a permutation iff each cycle is single-coloured, so it fixes m(number of cycles) colourings. That is the input to Burnside / Pólya (第23章).

Rotation by k of n positions has gcd(k, n) cycles, each of length n / gcd(k, n). A reflection of an n-gon has (n + 1)/2 cycles for odd n; for even n, half the reflections have n/2 cycles and half have n/2 + 1.
